protocol:
1. Place labeled microcentrifuge tubes containing samples in a green ice bucket and position an Invitrogen E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette on the bench near the E-Gel Power Snap system.

2. Open a labeled microcentrifuge tube from the ice bucket and use a single-channel adjustable micropipette with a disposable tip to pipette liquid from the tube.

3. Return the opened sample tube to the ice bucket between pipetting operations to keep the sample chilled.

4. Repeat pipetting from additional labeled microcentrifuge tubes kept on ice, changing or using disposable tips as needed.

5. Load a sample from a microcentrifuge tube into a well of the E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette using the single-channel micropipette.

6. Load additional sample into another well of the E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette using the same single-channel micropipette workflow.

7. Place the loaded E-Gel EX agarose gel cassette into the Invitrogen E-Gel Power Snap instrument.

8. Close the amber lid of the E-Gel Power Snap instrument over the gel cassette.

9. Select the gel run program on the E-Gel Power Snap touchscreen and set the run time to 10:00 min.

10. Start the E-Gel Power Snap run and allow the agarose gel electrophoresis to proceed; the display shows the countdown beginning from 10:00 min.
